title: Carvacrol mitigates chronic social isolation stress-induced depressive-like phenotypes via Nrf2-dependent antioxidant defense and downregulation of NF-kappaB proinflammatory pathway.
authors: Ameer, Muhammad Kamran; Ullah, Najeeb; Qazi, Neelum Gul; Ahmad, Habab Ali; Mehboob, Faiza; Badshah, Ismail; Khan, Muhammad Imran
one_liner_zh: 该文研究香芹酚通过Nrf2抗氧化和NF-κB抗炎通路缓解慢性社交隔离应激致抑郁样行为，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chronic social isolation stress (CSIS) disrupts redox homeostasis and promotes neuroinflammation, contributing to depressive-like behavior. Carvacrol (CV), a monoterpenoid phenol with antioxidants and anti-inflammatory properties, has been studied merely in stress-induced depression. Adult male NMRI mice underwent 6 weeks of CSIS and received CV (10 or 20 mg/kg, i.p.) or a positive control during the final 2 weeks. Depressive-like behavior was evaluated using open-field, splash, and forced-swim tests. Medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) and hippocampal dentate gyrus tissues were assayed for catalase (CAT) and glutathione-S-transferase (GST) activities, reduced glutathione (GSH), and lipid peroxidation (LPO; TBARS), together with selected proinflammatory cytokines. Hematoxylin-eosin staining assessed cytoarchitecture, and molecular docking examined putative interactions of CV with the Nrf2/Keap1 complex and NF-kappaB. CSIS increased behavioral despair and reduced exploration and grooming, accompanied by decreased CAT, GST, and GSH, elevated TBARS, and higher inflammatory mediators, with neuronal alterations in mPFC and dentate gyrus. CV dose-dependently improved locomotor and grooming behavior, restored antioxidant defenses, reduced TBARS, and lowered inflammatory markers while preserving neuronal structure. Docking supported plausible binding ( approximately  -5.8 kcal/mol for Nrf2/Keap1;  approximately  -5.1 kcal/mol for NF-kappaB), consistent with the observed molecular changes. These findings indicate that CV produces antidepressant-like effects in CSIS by reinforcing redox balance and attenuating neuroinflammation in stress-sensitive brain regions, supporting its therapeutic potential for stress-related mood disorder.
abstract_zh: 慢性社会隔离应激（CSIS）破坏氧化还原稳态并促进神经炎症，导致抑郁样行为。香芹酚（CV），一种具有抗氧化和抗炎特性的单萜酚类化合物，仅在应激诱导的抑郁中有所研究。成年雄性NMRI小鼠经历6周CSIS，并在最后2周接受CV（10或20 mg/kg，腹腔注射）或阳性对照。通过旷场、糖水偏好和强迫游泳测试评估抑郁样行为。检测内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）和海马齿状回组织中的过氧化氢酶（CAT）和谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）活性、还原型谷胱甘肽（GSH）及脂质过氧化（LPO；TBARS），以及选定的促炎细胞因子。苏木精-伊红染色评估细胞结构，分子对接考察CV与Nrf2/Keap1复合物及NF-kappaB的潜在相互作用。CSIS增加行为绝望并减少探索和梳理行为，伴随CAT、GST和GSH降低，TBARS升高，炎症介质增加，以及mPFC和齿状回中的神经元改变。CV剂量依赖性改善运动和行为梳理，恢复抗氧化防御，降低TBARS和炎症标志物，同时保持神经元结构。对接支持可能的结合（Nrf2/Keap1约为-5.8 kcal/mol；NF-kappaB约为-5.1 kcal/mol），与观察到的分子变化一致。这些发现表明，CV通过增强应激敏感脑区的氧化还原平衡和减轻神经炎症，在CSIS中产生抗抑郁样效应，支持其在应激相关情绪障碍中的治疗潜力。
